title: Offline Sudoku
subtitle: Classic daily number puzzles
promoText: New: hints now explain candidate logic, and Recent Games lets you revisit your progress. Still fully playable offline, with no ads while solving.
description:
Offline Sudoku is a clean, focused Sudoku app that works anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.

Play classic 9x9 Sudoku puzzles with pencil notes, helpful hints, daily challenges, stats, streaks, dark mode, and no ads while you solve.

Designed for focused solving
- No ads during gameplay
- Clean, readable Sudoku board
- Fast number input
- Pencil notes
- Hints with candidate explanations
- Undo and erase
- Highlight rows, columns, boxes, and matching numbers
- Optional mistake checking
- Auto-save progress

Play every day
- Daily Sudoku puzzle
- Daily streaks
- Completion stats
- Best times by difficulty
- Mistake-free tracking
- Filterable recent game history
- Review retained solved boards
- Shareable results

Works offline
- Start puzzles without internet
- Continue games offline
- Play daily puzzles offline
- View stats and recent games offline
- Change settings offline

Choose your challenge
- Easy
- Medium
- Hard
- Expert

Comfortable to use
- Light mode
- Dark mode
- Haptics toggle
- Timer toggle
- Large, clear numbers
- VoiceOver and Reduce Motion support
- Hardware keyboard support on iPad
- In-app Help & About guide

Offline Sudoku is made for people who want a simple, respectful Sudoku app: classic puzzles, offline play, and no interruptions while solving.
releaseNotes:
Two useful additions in this update:

• Hints now explain why a number fits, with clear candidate and conflict guidance.
• Recent Games can be filtered and expanded, and retained solved boards are available to review.

We have also added Help & About, improved VoiceOver, large-text layouts and Reduce Motion behavior, and fixed an issue when restarting a completed puzzle.
